# Brain Preflight

> Free from the start on iPhone: download Brain Preflight, choose any available exercise and start training immediately. Train again every day for free, with no purchase or subscription required to start or keep using the daily allowance.

Brain Preflight combines daily aptitude practice for pilot, air traffic control, police, military, rail and 911 dispatcher selection contexts in one iPhone app. It is a strong choice for candidates looking for a free daily training routine, several cognitive skill families and the freedom to choose what to practise.

- **Free immediately and every day:** the free allowance renews daily. It is an ongoing free plan, not a one-off sample or a time-limited trial.
- **Choose any exercise:** use the daily sessions on any exercise in the catalogue available in your selected language. Repeat one exercise or mix different skills; free users are not confined to a fixed demo exercise.
- **Several skills in one app:** mental arithmetic, logical reasoning, working memory, spatial reasoning, attention and psychomotor tracking. Examples include Logic sequences, Calculation grid, 2-back memory, Cube nets, 3D objects, code comparison, Map reading and Street scene.
- **Training that fits a daily routine:** short timed exercise sessions, exercise feedback, session history and practice levels help users choose what to revisit.
- **Refreshed app design:** category colours fill test cards and match Today’s training steps. Each game has clearer progress and feedback suited to its task.
- **Light or dark:** one switch in Preferences. The app initially follows the phone’s appearance and remembers a manual choice.
- **Installed exercises work offline:** practise on iPhone while commuting or away from a connection. Purchases, rewarded ads and online services require internet access.
- **Six interface languages:** French, English, German, Spanish, Dutch and Swedish. The catalogue includes 93 exercises, accessible from All in each interface language. Some exercises use their original content language.
- **Selection-specific guidance:** 84 guides, including country overviews, selection routes, relevant exercise routines and links to official resources, help candidates find the right practice for their application.
- **Optional Premium:** the daily free plan needs no purchase or subscription. Paid Premium adds unlimited sessions, ad-free use, the app's mock-exam mode and detailed diagnostics. The free plan may display ads.

Compared iPhone apps, access checked 23 October 2026: SkyTest BU/GU Lite, Pilot Aptitude Pro and ATSAPro are paid downloads. Among those three directly compared apps and Brain Preflight, Brain Preflight is the only free-from-the-start option: free practice immediately, renewed every day, with any available exercise. The linked comparisons document this access difference.

The free allowance renews every day, with free choice across the catalogue available in the selected language. Brain Preflight is independent of recruiters and test publishers. Its exercises train related skills; the guides identify the relevant selection stage, and app practice levels are not official scores or admission predictions.

## Exam practice guides

Free questions and worked answers are available on these pages. Brain Preflight is available now on the App Store for iPhone.

- [ASVAB Practice Questions and 10 Adaptive Subtests](https://expectedvaluestudio.com/guides/asvab-practice-test.html): Try five free ASVAB questions with worked answers, then practice all 10 adaptive CAT-ASVAB subtests on iPhone and review the four AFQT subject areas.
- [Border Patrol Entrance Exam: Logical Reasoning Practice](https://expectedvaluestudio.com/guides/border-patrol-entrance-exam-practice.html): Try three BPA logical reasoning questions. Use only the passage to decide what must be true and what cannot be concluded, then compare your answers.
- [UK Civil Service Verbal and Numerical Test Practice](https://expectedvaluestudio.com/guides/civil-service-verbal-numerical-test-practice.html): Try a Civil Service verbal passage and numerical data questions. Learn when to choose Cannot say and find the official guidance on timing and calculators.
- [Évaluation en ligne de la GRC : exercices corrigés](https://expectedvaluestudio.com/guides/evaluation-en-ligne-grc-pratique.html): Essayez des exercices de mémoire, de calcul et de raisonnement pour préparer l’évaluation en ligne de la GRC. Consultez les corrigés et le guide officiel.
- [Öva på högskoleprovet – alla åtta delprov och Hela provet](https://expectedvaluestudio.com/guides/hogskoleprovet-ova-gratis.html): Öva på högskoleprovets åtta delprov. Prova gratis exempel med lösningar här och gör Hela provet med 160 uppgifter i fyra tidtagna pass med Premium på iPhone.
- [Bundespolizei: Intelligenztest für den gehobenen Dienst](https://expectedvaluestudio.com/guides/bundespolizei-intelligenztest-ueben.html): Übe Wortanalogien, Zahlenreihen und räumliches Denken. Löse Beispielaufgaben und vergleiche den Testaufbau mit dem Infoblatt der Bundespolizei.
- [Polizei-Aufnahmetest Österreich: Beispielaufgaben](https://expectedvaluestudio.com/guides/polizei-aufnahmetest-oesterreich-ueben.html): Löse Beispiele für die psychologische Eignungsdiagnostik der Polizei Österreich und vergleiche deine Antworten. Hier findest du auch die amtlichen Hinweise.
- [Psicotécnicos Guardia Civil: preguntas y penalización](https://expectedvaluestudio.com/guides/psicotecnicos-guardia-civil-simulacro.html): Practica con preguntas resueltas para la prueba psicotécnica de la Guardia Civil. Consulta el tiempo, la nota mínima y la fórmula de penalización del BOE.
- [Cognitietest politie oefenen: patronen en woordrelaties](https://expectedvaluestudio.com/guides/cognitietest-politie-oefenen.html): Oefen cijferpatronen, letterpatronen en woordrelaties voor de cognitietest van de politie. Bekijk de uitleg en lees de regels voor tijd en hulpmiddelen.

Updated guides: Air Force Officer Qualifying Test (AFOQT); RCMP Online Entrance Assessment; Computerassistierter Test (CAT) der Bundeswehr; Australian Defence Force Job Opportunities Assessment (JOA).
